sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed on a weekly, semiannual, and annually 
bases as indicated by W1, M6 and Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Haytham Hemdan, 
reviewed by eng. Mohamed Abbass Ahmed, revised by EDEPC quality control 
eng. Adel Abdul Kader El Naggar, approved by eng. Tarek Youssef Ali, Head Sector of 
Ayoun Moussa Power Station.

هذا 
الوثيقة مقبولة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل EDEPC التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
المدير العام، منسق MPIS، و 
معتمد من قبل المحاسب محمود سليمان EDEPC المشرف والتفتيش المالي 
مدير عام مراقبة الجودة ومشرف التفتيش والجودة 
السيطرة على قطاع الرأس.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance stuff 
 should carry the suitable ID safety category
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل
Wear the appropriate safety equipment as safety shoes and helmet

It will be necessary to wear high voltage proof gloves for brush holder 
 removal from or insertion into the carrier ring while the unit is in excited 
 condition

To ensure proper field current transfer during checks and maintenance 
 activities, remove only one plug-in brush holder at a time for each polarity.
 Removing the next brush holder is only permissible after the first one has 
 been reinserted and positively participated in the field current transfer.

sections.text:
The excitation power 
requirements for the respective loads should be monitored continuously and 
entered into the operating log at regular intervals together with any special 
occurrences.

The wear of each 
individual brush can be checked during operation without removing the brush 
holder by inserting a gage stick of insulating material into the bore of the 
telescopic plunger. The gage stick is provided with several notch marks showing 
the useful length of the carbon brush. see figure 1.

The brush is worn down to 
the permissible limit and must be replaced when the gage stick can be inserted 
into the bore so that the inner end face of the stick handle beds against the 
telescopic plunger.

sections.text:
Replacing carbon brushes 
is possible during all operating and load conditions of the unit.

To remove a plug-in brush 
holder, press the handle toward the telescopic plunger the carbon brush is thus 
locked in its guide through a clamping pin and the brush holder released from 
its lock in the carrier ring.

The carbon brushes 
themselves should be replaced a way from the slip rings to avoid any hazard from 
this work during operation.

After installing the new 
carbon brush, the first notch mark of the inserted gage stick will coincide with 
the top of the telescopic plunger.

Checking Slip Rings
Heavily contaminated slip 
rings have to be cleaned during unit outages.
Clean brushes and dry 
linen cloths leaving no fluff should preferably be used for this purpose.
The use of a cleaning 
liquid (Rivolta or equivalent) may be helpful.
See figure 5.

The carbon brushes should 
be checked at regular intervals.

inspection.
